supplements.title: Chenopodium ambrosioides Linn. induces mitochondrial-dependent cell death via activation of mPT pore opening, caspases and apoptotic machinery.
supplements.summary: Chenopodium ambrosioides plant extract kills cancer cells by opening mitochondrial pores and triggering programmed cell death.

supplements.title: MPN-FIT: a randomized controlled pilot trial of supervised exercise in myeloproliferative neoplasms.
supplements.summary: Supervised exercise in myeloproliferative neoplasm patients reduced disease markers and improved quality of life, proving feasible and acceptable.

supplements.title: Physical Activity Monitoring in Adolescents and Young Adults With Cancer: Observational Feasibility Study.
supplements.summary: Wearable devices can track physical activity in young cancer patients, but their accuracy depends on how consistently patients wear them.

supplements.title: Novel benzofuran/pterostilbene hybrids trigger programmed cell death and impair migration in CRC cells.
supplements.summary: Novel benzofuran-pterostilbene hybrid compounds kill colorectal cancer cells and reduce their ability to spread by targeting key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Unlocking p-coumaric acid's potential against biofilm-forming extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii: in vitro and in vivo study.
supplements.summary: P-coumaric acid successfully breaks down dangerous bacterial biofilms and restores antibiotic effectiveness against drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii infections.

supplements.title: Synergistic anticancer effects of peanut hairy root culture crude extract in combination with gemcitabine against cholangiocarcinoma.
supplements.summary: Peanut extract combined with gemcitabine effectively kills cholangiocarcinoma cancer cells and shrinks tumors in mice.

supplements.title: Yixinyuan Gaofang ameliorates myocardial infarction in rats by inhibiting the TNF/NF-κB pathway.
supplements.summary: A Chinese herbal medicine reduced heart attack damage in rats by suppressing inflammation and oxidative stress through the TNF/NF-κB pathway.

supplements.title: Fortified Chestnut Honey Triggers Apoptosis in Colon Cancer Cells.
supplements.summary: Fortified chestnut honey kills colon cancer cells while sparing normal cells, suggesting potential as a complementary cancer therapy.

supplements.title: Daklakamitocins A-I, Brominated Maytansinoid Glycosides from Amycolatopsis sp. CK6 with Antiproliferative Activity.
supplements.summary: Brominated compounds from bacteria show stronger cancer cell-killing activity than their chlorinated counterparts, suggesting bromine enhances effectiveness.

supplements.title: Celastrol inhibits the immune escape and proliferation of triple - negative breast cancer (TNBC) through the LKB1 - AMPK - PD-L1/MYC signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Celastrol, a natural compound, stops triple-negative breast cancer growth and helps the immune system attack tumors by blocking a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Multiscale analysis and optimal glioma therapeutic candidate discovery using the CANDO platform.
supplements.summary: Researchers used the CANDO computational platform to discover 24 promising glioma drug candidates by analyzing how compounds interact with brain tumor proteins.

supplements.title: Pyrroloquinoline quinone scaffolds: centrality in anticancer drug design.
supplements.summary: PQQ, a naturally occurring compound with antitumor potential, warrants clinical testing combined with existing cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Apigenin Inhibits Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Growth by Dual Targeting GPX4/SLC7A11-Mediated Ferroptosis and PKM2/GLUT1-Mediated Aerobic Glycolysis.
supplements.summary: Apigenin, a natural compound, inhibits triple-negative breast cancer growth by triggering cell death through two mechanisms: ferroptosis and blocking energy production.

supplements.title: Molecular Insights Into Phytochemicals as Modulators in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds like curcumin and resveratrol show promise in fighting oral cancer by targeting its molecular growth mechanisms.

supplements.title: Pyroptosis as a double-edged sword in colorectal cancer: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
supplements.summary: Pyroptosis, a cell death process, shows dual roles in colorectal cancer—it can either promote or suppress tumors—offering new therapeutic opportunities.

off_label.title: Multiscale analysis and optimal glioma therapeutic candidate discovery using the CANDO platform.
off_label.summary: Researchers used the CANDO computational platform to discover 24 promising glioma drug candidates by analyzing how compounds interact with brain tumor proteins.

off_label.title: Studying Synergistic Anticancer Effects of Repurposed AT1B Losartan with Antidiabetics Metformin, Rosiglitazone in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Losartan combined with metformin shows synergistic effects in killing triple-negative breast cancer cells more effectively than either drug alone.

off_label.title: Avapritinib for targeting KIT D816V-mutated acute myeloid leukemia relapsed after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant with extramedullary and central nervous system involvement.
off_label.summary: Drug avapritinib effectively treats relapsed acute myeloid leukemia with specific KIT mutation, even in brain and multiple organs.

off_label.title: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy: emerging role and novel therapeutic target in precision oncology.
off_label.summary: NCOA4-mediated ferritin breakdown triggers iron-dependent cancer cell death, offering a new treatment strategy to overcome drug resistance.

off_label.title: Targeting CB1 and TRPM8 receptors to counteract CD8+ T cell exhaustion.
off_label.summary: Blocking CB1 receptors reduced exhaustion markers on immune cells, potentially improving cancer treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pharmacological Treatments for Cancer-Related Anorexia-Cachexia Syndrome: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses.
off_label.summary: Researchers reviewed treatments for cancer-related appetite loss and muscle wasting, evaluating which drugs work best to help patients maintain weight.

off_label.title: Low-Dose Aspirin and Central Presbycusis: A Substudy of the ASPREE Randomized Clinical Trial.
off_label.summary: Low-dose aspirin may help slow age-related hearing loss in older adults by reducing inflammation and blood vessel problems.

off_label.title: Protective effect of nebivolol on bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis via suppressing TLR4/IL-1β/MMP-2 and TGF-β/HSP47 signaling pathways in rats.
off_label.summary: Nebivolol, a heart medication, protected rat lungs from bleomycin-induced scarring by blocking harmful inflammatory and fibrosis pathways.

off_label.title: Interconnection between Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, Immune Disorders, and Reproductive Outcomes.
off_label.summary: PCOS involves chronic inflammation and immune dysfunction that damage ovarian function and reduce pregnancy success, suggesting immune-targeted treatments could help.

off_label.title: Plasmin promotes hepatocellular carcinoma invasion and metastasis via CXCR4-mediated activation of PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling.
off_label.summary: Plasmin promotes liver cancer invasion and metastasis; blocking it with tranexamic acid suppresses tumor spread and enhances chemotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Metformin treatment impairs the adenine nucleotide translocator activity and energy metabolism in human clear cell renal carcinoma cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills kidney cancer cells by disrupting their energy production and forcing them to switch to less efficient metabolism.

off_label.title: Targeting G3BP1-Mediated Stress Granules to Suppress SARS-CoV-2 Replication.
off_label.summary: Two FDA-approved drugs, dexlansoprazole and citalopram, reduced SARS-CoV-2 replication by disrupting viral-host protein interactions in stress granules.

off_label.title: Liver cancer-derived exosomal PTK6 induces the secretion of pulmonary CHI3L1 to facilitate lung metastatic niche formation.
off_label.summary: Liver cancer cells send signals that trigger lung cells to produce a protein enabling lung metastasis; blocking this protein reduces cancer spread.

off_label.title: Targeting NDUFS4 Disrupts Oxidative Phosphorylation and Induces Ferroptosis in Olaparib-Resistant Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NDUFS4 in drug-resistant prostate cancer restores sensitivity to PARP inhibitors by disrupting energy production and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Dexamethasone for Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea and Vomiting Prevention in Pediatric Patients: International Consensus.
off_label.summary: Experts created guidelines on when dexamethasone safely prevents chemotherapy nausea in children, weighing its benefits against risks.

biomarkers.title: Cost comparison of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed versus amivantamab plus lazertinib for the first-line treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic epidermal growth factor receptor-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.
biomarkers.summary: New drug combinations for EGFR-mutated lung cancer show better results, but a cost analysis compares their affordability for patients.

biomarkers.title: Desmoid Tumors-Biology-Driven Management and Treatment Selection.
biomarkers.summary: Desmoid tumors are now managed through observation and targeted drugs rather than aggressive surgery, improving patient outcomes and quality of life.

biomarkers.title: Lancet2: Improved and accelerated somatic variant calling with joint multi-sample local assembly graphs.
biomarkers.summary: Lancet2 improves detection of cancer-causing DNA mutations in tumor samples, offering faster analysis and better accuracy than existing tools.

biomarkers.title: SpNeigh: spatial neighborhood and differential expression analysis for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics.
biomarkers.summary: SpNeigh software analyzes gene expression patterns while preserving tissue location, revealing hidden cell populations and spatial gene patterns in cancer and normal tissues.

biomarkers.title: MYC and AP-1 oncogenes cooperatively bind enhancers to rewire transcription.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer cells with high MYC levels use AP-1 cooperation at enhancers to rewire gene expression and promote cancer growth.

biomarkers.title: Wooden-Tip Electrospray Ionization Mass Spectrometry Combined With Machine Learning for Differentiating Thyroid Tumours.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a rapid wooden-tip mass spectrometry method with machine learning to quickly distinguish healthy thyroid tissue from benign and malignant thyroid tumors.

biomarkers.title: HOXD9 affecting glioma proliferation and invasion.
biomarkers.summary: Reducing HOXD9 gene expression slows glioma cell growth and spread, making it a potential treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Dominant-negative PSMB10 disrupts immunoproteasome assembly and leads to transient T lymphopenia.
biomarkers.summary: A mutation disrupting immunoproteasome assembly causes temporary T cell loss in a newborn, but surprisingly resolves naturally within the first year.

biomarkers.title: Profile of Helen M. Piwnica-Worms.
biomarkers.summary: Researcher identifies how BRCA1-mutant breast cancer cells escape drug treatment, suggesting new combination therapy approaches.

biomarkers.title: Chenopodium ambrosioides Linn. induces mitochondrial-dependent cell death via activation of mPT pore opening, caspases and apoptotic machinery.
biomarkers.summary: Chenopodium ambrosioides plant extract kills cancer cells by opening mitochondrial pores and triggering programmed cell death.

biomarkers.title: Amoeboid-mesenchymal transition and the proteolytic control of cancer invasion plasticity.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer cells require the enzyme MMP14 to invade tissue by degrading collagen barriers, regardless of invasion strategy.

biomarkers.title: Modulating IDO1 and TDO Inhibition Through Structural Modification of Diaryl Hydroxylamines.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers designed modified compounds that effectively inhibit IDO1 and TDO enzymes, which help tumors escape immune detection, potentially enhancing cancer immunotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Advances in Electrochemical Biosensors for Circulating Tumor Cell Detection.
biomarkers.summary: Electrochemical biosensors enable sensitive detection of circulating tumor cells in blood through electrical signal conversion, improving cancer diagnosis and monitoring.

biomarkers.title: Pyrazolone Compounds as Promising Anticancer Agents for Colorectal Cancer: Synthesis, Antiproliferative Activity, and Mechanistic Insights.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a new compound called PL-13 that effectively kills colorectal cancer cells by triggering apoptosis while sparing healthy cells.

biomarkers.title: Clinical outcomes of older patients with NPM1-mutated or KMT2A-rearranged AML before menin inhibitors: a Beat AML report.
biomarkers.summary: Older patients with specific acute myeloid leukemia mutations had poor outcomes before a new menin inhibitor treatment became available.

trials.title: Effects of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on the Psychological Well-Being of Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
trials.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions significantly reduce anxiety and depression in family caregivers of cancer patients.

trials.title: Cost comparison of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed versus amivantamab plus lazertinib for the first-line treatment of patients with locally advanced or metastatic epidermal growth factor receptor-mutated non-small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: New drug combinations for EGFR-mutated lung cancer show better results, but a cost analysis compares their affordability for patients.

trials.title: Desmoid Tumors-Biology-Driven Management and Treatment Selection.
trials.summary: Desmoid tumors are now managed through observation and targeted drugs rather than aggressive surgery, improving patient outcomes and quality of life.

trials.title: Profile of Helen M. Piwnica-Worms.
trials.summary: Researcher identifies how BRCA1-mutant breast cancer cells escape drug treatment, suggesting new combination therapy approaches.

trials.title: 2-Phenylquinolines Exhibit Anti-Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus-2 Activity Through the Nonstructural Protein 13 Helicase Inhibition.
trials.summary: New 2-phenylquinoline compounds block SARS-CoV-2 by inhibiting viral helicase protein, showing broad-spectrum coronavirus activity and safety potential.

trials.title: Clinical outcomes of older patients with NPM1-mutated or KMT2A-rearranged AML before menin inhibitors: a Beat AML report.
trials.summary: Older patients with specific acute myeloid leukemia mutations had poor outcomes before a new menin inhibitor treatment became available.

trials.title: Clonal dynamics, tolerance, and adverse events after CD45-ADC-conditioned autologous HSPC transplantation in macaques.
trials.summary: CD45-ADC conditioning in macaques enabled gene-modified cell engraftment but triggered immune rejection; lower doses with immunosuppression showed promise for durable transplantation.

trials.title: Targeting Aurora kinase A to prevent GVHD and relapse after myeloablative allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.
trials.summary: Aurora kinase A inhibitor combined with existing drugs reduced severe graft-versus-host disease and relapse after bone marrow transplantation with promising early survival.

trials.title: Treatment and survival outcomes for patients with follicular lymphoma and POD24: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: CAR T-cell therapy and bispecific antibodies show promising high response rates in aggressive follicular lymphoma cases with early disease progression.

trials.title: Advancing precision therapy in pediatric acute myeloid leukemia through PDX models and mitochondrial targeting.
trials.summary: Patient-derived models reveal that combining mitochondrial and cell survival inhibitors effectively targets pediatric acute myeloid leukemia.

trials.title: Serum free fatty acid promotes tumor progression and predicts golidocitinib sensitivity in peripheral T-cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: High blood fatty acids promote peripheral T-cell lymphoma progression and predict better response to the drug golidocitinib.

trials.title: Improved survival and health care use with CAR-T vs historical care in relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma.
trials.summary: CAR-T immunotherapy dramatically improved survival and reduced hospitalizations compared to previous treatments for relapsed large B-cell lymphoma.

trials.title: Zamtocabtagene autoleucel in relapsed/refractory B-NHL: 5-year follow-up of a CD20/19 tandem CAR T-cell phase 1 trial.
trials.summary: A dual-targeted CAR T-cell therapy for relapsed B-cell lymphoma achieved 42% complete remission with durable responses lasting five years and minimal severe side effects.

trials.title: MPN-FIT: a randomized controlled pilot trial of supervised exercise in myeloproliferative neoplasms.
trials.summary: Supervised exercise in myeloproliferative neoplasm patients reduced disease markers and improved quality of life, proving feasible and acceptable.

trials.title: Progressive cervicothoracic meningocele with neurovascular compression and spinal deformity in neurofibromatosis type 1: a decade-long radiological and clinical evolution with operative repair. Illustrative case.
trials.summary: Doctors successfully surgically repaired a rare progressive spinal fluid sac in a neurofibromatosis patient that was compressing nearby nerves and blood vessels.

mind_body.title: Effects of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on the Psychological Well-Being of Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions significantly reduce anxiety and depression in family caregivers of cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Dehydration in the Dying Process: An Integrative Systematic Review of Physiological Mechanisms and Clinical Implications.
mind_body.summary: Terminal dehydration in dying patients is an adaptive process; artificial hydration increases respiratory secretions and discomfort without clear benefits.

mind_body.title: Psychotherapeutic Techniques for Dyspnea in Cancer and Chronic Illness: Systematic Review.
mind_body.summary: Psychotherapy techniques effectively help cancer and seriously ill patients manage breathing difficulties, though delivery methods need better understanding.

mind_body.title: Pilot study of the DeStress for Health Program: a community-engaged stress reduction and cancer prevention intervention for rural communities.
mind_body.summary: A stress-reduction program showed promise in helping rural communities adopt healthier behaviors that could lower cancer risk.

mind_body.title: AI-enabled psychometric and psychophysiological assessment in psychiatric comorbidity of oncology patients: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: AI tools can better detect depression and anxiety in cancer patients by continuously monitoring psychological distress beyond traditional screening methods.

mind_body.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
mind_body.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

mind_body.title: Communication skill training in surgical residency: insights from Y-SICO (Young-Italian Society of Surgical Oncology).
mind_body.summary: Most surgical residents lack formal communication training despite recognizing its importance for delivering difficult diagnoses and managing patient care.

mind_body.title: Beyond tumor biology: nursing interventions for psychological and immune health in cancer patients.
mind_body.summary: Nursing interventions combining therapy, mindfulness, and lifestyle support improve psychological well-being and immune function in cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Breast cancer survivor and body: Exploring self-defining memories in an intervention pilot study.
mind_body.summary: A new psychological intervention helps breast cancer survivors process traumatic body-related memories and improve well-being.

mind_body.title: Five-Element Music and VR for Pain and Psychological Distress in Advanced Cancer: A Randomized Trial.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy and virtual reality together reduced pain and psychological distress in advanced cancer patients more effectively than standard care alone.

mind_body.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

mind_body.title: How does self-compassion affect posttraumatic adaptation among lymphoma patients? A perspective based on network analysis.
mind_body.summary: Self-compassion components distinctly influence posttraumatic stress and growth differently in lymphoma patients through network analysis.

mind_body.title: A National Needs Assessment Identifies Training Gap in Integrative Oncology Education.
mind_body.summary: Most cancer doctors want integrative oncology training, but educational programs remain limited, creating a significant nationwide training gap.

mind_body.title: [Experience and access to acupuncture in patients undergoing anticancer treatment: A multicentric cross-sectional cohort study].
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients undergoing treatment rarely access acupuncture for managing side effects, despite reporting interest in this complementary therapy option.

mind_body.title: Association of marital and parental status with stress, support, adherence, and quality of life among breast cancer women.
mind_body.summary: Marital and parental status significantly influence stress levels, emotional support, treatment compliance, and quality of life in breast cancer patients.
